title: Thank you to the people building these AI tools
excerpt: This stuff has impacted my work and the well-being of my family in a positive way.
content_html:
This stuff has impacted my work and the well-being of my family in a positive way.

It is easy to take these tools for granted due to the fear surrounding them and the sheer volume of activity in the space. It's hard to keep up and it's a wild ride.

I appreciate that I get to have a high-level, well-versed thinking partner in my pocket 24/7 who builds things for me, to my spec, for $500-600/mo USD.

Learning these new probabilistic systems is a fun and challenging endeavor.

AI tools have enabled me to build the things that make my life's mission possible - teaching people how to keep kids safe on the Internet.

I am grateful. Thank you.

What's the most positive thing you've seen come from your work with AI tools?

content_html_zh:
这些东西对我的工作和家庭的福祉产生了积极的影响。

由于周围的恐惧和空间中的大量活动，人们很容易认为这些工具是理所当然的。 很难跟上，这是一次疯狂的旅程。

我很高兴能有一个高水平、精通思想的合作伙伴 24/7 全天候为我构建东西，符合我的规格，价格为 500-600 美元/月。

学习这些新的概率系统是一项有趣且具有挑战性的工作。

人工智能工具使我能够构建一些东西，使我的人生使命成为可能——教人们如何保证孩子在互联网上的安全。

我很感激。 谢谢。
